scope: Re-run of local.plc_object_mutations.20261028, whose raw report was lost: scripts/qualify_plc_object_mutations.py on a frozen Debug build of 2d5aa7c (D:/wp/b65) in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN (V21), 369/369 steps: tag_set, tag_create, tag_delete, constant_set, constant_create, constant_delete, tag_table_import_xml, type_source_upsert, type_rename, type_delete, plc_type_import_xml, source_upsert (SCL), block_import_xml, block_rename, block_delete, block_number_set, block_attributes_set (HeaderAuthor/HeaderFamily on an FB), group_create, group_rename, group_delete, plc_compile and instance_db_create each applied with exact preview assertions, checkpoint, compile and save; a complete export of every block, type and table plus every tag, constant and group differed from the previous one in exactly the intended keys; unchanged type and DB reimports showed no difference; typed prepare-time refusals per kind left the inventory unchanged and PreviewMismatch, StaleRevision and compile=false were refused at apply; a fresh owned Portal reopened the saved project with the identical verified state; from the reopened state one more change per kind was applied and restored by change_restore into a new directory equal to the pre-change state; a deliberately failing tag address (%M20000.0) ended CompileFailed/recovery_required with its checkpoint retained and change_restore refused FingerprintUnavailable on the inconsistent block.
limitations: One owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN at PLC-root scope: no software units, namespaces, safety, know-how protection or generated system-group objects.
SCL blocks and one global DB only; LAD/FBD/STL targets, OB attributes, HeaderName and HeaderVersion are not written. Renamed and deleted groups were empty or held only a subgroup.
A change whose compile fails leaves an inconsistent user block; change_restore then refuses (FingerprintUnavailable) by design and the retained checkpoint is the recovery input.
Engineering only; runtime behavior is not observed.
